description:
From lethal injection's alarming seven percent failure rate to the electric chair's horrifying malfunctions, this episode ranks execution methods still used worldwide today. Examining hanging, beheading, firing squads, and the controversial new nitrogen hypoxia system, it reveals how attempts at creating humane execution methods consistently fall short of their promises.
